goal: Implement the accepted Codex Directory Creation Contract in the existing Work Unit schema, project/framework validators, consumer-projection/scope tests, and AGENTS/bootstrap operating contract so undeclared durable directory creation fails closed without adding a second manager, registry, or state store.

requirements: Execution requires a separate exact Instruction for this Work Unit and an independent native PRE_EXECUTION PASS. This Work Unit alone grants no execution authority.

Freshly verify repository identity, origin/main, STATE revision 18, Framework version 2.7.4, immutable accepted Design/Plan refs, and exact owned/excluded scope before execution; authority drift requires reconciliation rather than automatic rebasing.

Add an optional directory_creations field to the existing Work Unit schema. Each declaration must require path, purpose, owner, content_type, authority_type, lifetime, consumer_visible, release_visible, and cleanup_policy; declaration syntax must be repository-relative, deterministic, and fail closed on malformed or missing required fields.

CREATE_DIRECTORY_DEFAULT=DENY. A durable directory prefix absent from BASE_GIT_TREE must not be introduced in CANDIDATE_GIT_TREE unless an applicable directory_creations declaration authorizes it and the new tracked path is also within Work Unit/Instruction scope.
A new top-level directory requires explicit accepted Architecture/Design authority. Missing authority must return STRUCTURE_CHANGE_REQUIRED rather than silently relying on parent scope.

Distinguish EXISTING_DIRECTORY_WRITE from NEW_DIRECTORY_CREATION by comparing tracked BASE_GIT_TREE and CANDIDATE_GIT_TREE directory prefixes. A broad parent selector never authorizes arbitrary new descendants.
Candidate validation must account for added and renamed tracked paths so rename/add operations cannot evade directory-prefix comparison. Deletions alone must not be treated as directory creation.
Reject undeclared, out-of-scope, malformed, or generic-purpose new directory declarations with DIRECTORY_CREATION_DENIED. Reject unauthorized new top-level prefixes with STRUCTURE_CHANGE_REQUIRED.

Generic/scratch names including new, final2, copy, backup, tmp, fix2, and latest-final are denied for durable repository directory creation even when a declaration exists unless the accepted Design explicitly names and justifies that exact semantic path.

Repo-local candidate workspaces, temporary ZIP/unpacked output, caches, scratch output, review copies, and backups remain forbidden durable repository content; ephemeral build/review artifacts belong outside the repository.

Preserve existing governed mutation, role, project identity, consumer projection, Git continuity, Work Unit scope, and immutable artifact-ref behavior. Directory declarations assert bounded authority and never self-authorize execution.
Update WORK_UNIT.template.json to show the optional directory_creations contract without making it mandatory for Work Units that create no directory.

Update AGENTS.md and .gpt-codex/BOOTSTRAP_PROMPT.md with the same operating contract and deterministic future worktree layout semantics, while explicitly deferring any actual local workspace move/reorganization.

Add/extend focused tests for existing-directory writes, declared nested directory creation, authorized top-level directory creation, undeclared nested/top-level directory creation, missing declaration fields, generic names, rename/add paths, broad-parent-scope denial, and repo-local scratch/cache/archive/review-output denial.

Extend existing consumer-projection/scope tests only as needed to prove the updated schema/template/AGENTS/bootstrap contract remains in the consumer projection and management-only test artifacts do not leak into staged consumer output.
Do not create a second directory manager, registry, database, queue, daemon, STATE field/value, module subsystem, or runtime service.

Do not create any of the future docs/architecture, docs/decisions, docs/plans, or docs/history prefixes in this Phase C Work Unit. Phase D must exercise the newly enforced contract under separate authority.

Run focused directory-contract tests, project validation, framework validation, consumer projection validation, the relevant module required tests, and git diff --check. The exit condition is that an unauthorized new tracked Git directory prefix fails closed even when no mkdir command appears.
CODEX_IMPLEMENTER has no COMMIT or PUSH authority. Exact reviewed implementation candidates require independent POST_EXECUTION review and separate user-accepted durable integration.
